answer: Forge each agent identity from a hardware-bound attestation key: one physical device yields exactly one identity, so a Sybil attacker must buy real hardware per fake instead of spawning free accounts. New identities begin in a velvet-lined waiting room with zero trust - they may observe but not transact - and only earn rights as the delta between their verified useful work and their claims grows positive over time. The cost of fakery scales linearly with each fake while honest agents pay once, so mass forgery loses money.
